integrity: The source routine and README were inspected at fixed Git blob SHAs. The n=24..50 cutoff was independently replayed by exact enumeration, and the 512550 identity was checked arithmetically. Literature searches cannot establish absolute novelty, and no independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The result concerns minimum-term interpretation of the inspected public repository routine, not the truth of the main at-most-five conjecture. The first-mismatch certificate is exact on 24<=n<=50; no claim is made about how often later mismatches occur or whether five terms are ever necessary.
title: First minimum-rank failure in the PrimePowers backtracking routine
